question: What example shows that conditions can transform the experience of light?
premises: The sun is normally hard to look at.
When its light falls on water, it can delight the eyes.
The medium changes how the light is experienced.
inference: The example of sunlight on water shows the effectiveness of limiting conditions in shaping the appearance of light.
plain_english: Even the sun, which is hard to look at, becomes delightful to the eyes when its light falls on water. See how powerful a conditioning medium can be.
